summary: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of all outstanding equity interests of Keller Companies, Inc. and its subsidiaries, including Kalwall Corporation and Structures Unlimited, Inc., for $105 million in cash at closing plus up to $10 million in contingent consideration based on future performance. The acquisition was funded with available cash and borrowings under its revolving credit facility. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor is named. The deal closed on July 1, 2026, with customary post-closing adjustments. Watch for potential earn-out achievement and integration risk as Apogee expands its architectural products portfolio.
